$comment: Configuration for scripts/verify-fresh-html.ts and the Live cache + freshness gate. Edit this file to change routes, regions, and prior-deploy hashes without touching code.

previousDeployHashes.$comment: Optional. Map of `${regionId}::${route}` -> sha256 of the served HTML from the LAST known-good deploy. If the verifier sees the same hash again after a fresh publish, it fails: the CDN is still serving stale HTML. Update this file when you cut a new deploy, or leave empty to skip the check.
